testcase.name: waypoints and offline regions resolve directly from the entry's own snapshot, no repository involved
a withheld (not kept) track is never resolved, even if it still exists
a photo whose gallery row is missing entirely is skipped silently
a kept track deleted from Records with no saved path draws nothing and does not error
a withheld track's saved path is not drawn
a kept track deleted from Records draws its saved line and does not error
nothing kept resolves to an entirely empty result
a saved path that cannot be read draws nothing for that track, the other tracks still draw, and nothing throws
a kept find deleted from Records draws nothing and does not error
a photo with no coordinate is skipped silently, not an error
a kept find with a resolved coordinate becomes a find marker
a kept find with no location produces no find marker, not an error
an empty saved path contributes no polyline, as an empty live track does not
allPoints flattens every resolved category together
a photo with a resolved coordinate becomes a photo marker
two kept tracks resolve to two separate polylines, each with its own points
a kept track whose every stored point is excluded at the read seam contributes no polyline at all
the live track is drawn, not the saved path, while the track exists
another entry's saved path for the same track is not drawn
